svg.text: PROPOSED seeker state matrix · landscape-narrow-computed · strip band at true scale (dp)
Each row is the 76 dp band of the #142 target; left column is the band, right column the rule. Synthetic media; dark theme row tones alternate with light.
Strip as #142: video is one 44×56 tile, ring + sphere on it. Photo strip rules apply.
Finger down on centred video, within touch slop. Nothing moves yet. Moving > slop =
Hold reached 180 ms [OBSERVED V16]: tile expands in place to N frames over 200 ms Lift;
Span follows finger 1:1. Main view = nearest cached frame. Tick when playhead crosses a
Finger still: decoder frame (CLOSEST_SYNC seek) replaces the cached tile in the main
EXACT seek decodes the frame at T; audio/neighbour work allowed. Nothing in the strip
Platform spline decay ×1.0 within the span; preview follows; clamps at 0 / end without
Finger down stops the span where it is; that time becomes the new drag origin; no seek is
Commit T at release (or fling end). Offset, sphere, elapsed text unchanged. Resume if it
Span's left edge sits under the playhead; further drag is clamped (no pager hand-off
Clamped at the last frame time d−1 frame; same rule.
Mist #14152A tile, no glyph or text. Main view keeps last good frame until the decoder
Hold does not expand; strip stays a photo strip; #142 error state on the page. Mid-drag
Seeker not offered; hold does nothing (no tick).
N = 25 frames, span 1100 dp; span scrolls past both screen edges.
Hold is not used. Video tile gets custom action 'Seek through frames'; adjustable steps
Expand/collapse and preview cross-fade cut; finger-driven drag and fling physics
No text in the strip; video row reflows above (#142 F3); band geometry identical.
